In detail

The southern edge: Borgo Roma, Basso Acquar and, further out, Ca' di David. Borgo Roma is named in 2026 police prevention reporting as one of the neighbourhoods where past problems have prompted continued monitoring. It is a working residential area a long way from the Arena, with little to bring a visitor here.
